item.text:
**REJECT.** `XmlTokenStream::new(source, 0)` and budgets smaller than one `XmlToken` now succeed, then fail during parsing with `OutputExhausted`. The accepted C constructor rejects those budgets immediately with `StreamStatus::Failed` semantics: [xml_tokenizer.c](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust-xml-storage/src/svg/xml/xml_tokenizer.c:697). The candidate explicitly records this behavior change in its parity map and blesses it in the boundary test: [stream_tests.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.worktrees/rust-xml-storage/rust/crates/vexel-xml/src/stream_tests.rs:263). This violates the work order’s preserved API behavior. Restore constructor-time rejection and change those assertions to expect constructor failure; keep the new storage API additive.
